failed_audits.title: <html> element does not have a [lang] attribute
failed_audits.user_impact: Screen readers cannot determine the page language pronunciation rules.
failed_audits.proposed_fix: Add lang="en" to the root <html> element.

failed_audits.title: Image elements do not have [alt] attributes
failed_audits.user_impact: Blind users using screen readers hear the raw data URI instead of the brand purpose.
failed_audits.proposed_fix: Add alt="InvenTree Purchasing Module Logo" to the header brand .

failed_audits.title: Buttons do not have an accessible name
failed_audits.user_impact: Assistive technology announces "button, blank" without explaining what clicking it does.
failed_audits.proposed_fix: Add aria-label="Refresh Purchase Orders and Stock Balances" and visible text.

failed_audits.title: Form elements do not have associated labels
failed_audits.user_impact: Screen reader and voice-control users cannot identify which field each input represents.
failed_audits.proposed_fix: Replace unlinked <span> tags with explicit <label for="input-..."> elements.

failed_audits.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio
failed_audits.element: span#active-role-badge (color: #b5b5b5 on #ffffff, contrast ratio 2.02:1 < 4.5:1 WCAG AA)
failed_audits.user_impact: Low-vision users cannot read the active role status indicator.
failed_audits.proposed_fix: Change badge colors to #ffffff on #0b5394 (contrast ratio 8.15:1 >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA).
